set.body: Define backend-neutral layout and guide contracts before adding more renderers. Acceptance: typed panel/frame/margin layout, coordinate transforms from data/native space into panel space, guide specs for axes and legends, and lowering of guides to existing Axis/Scene grobs. SVG remains a consumer of Scene only. Tests cover fixed-size panel layout, axis placement, clipping policy, and guide output stability on JVM and JS.
set.title: Graphics: add panel layout, coordinate, and guide contracts
